structured.answer: I haven't decided. I'll ask my son or the bank. The page says the cheapest is a Psagot account with the 'ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500' fund, ending with about 86,492 ₪ from 70,000 ₪ put in over 10 years (at 7% a year). Leumi would leave about 83,396 ₪, and I'd feel safer there.

stuck.why: Too many coloured labels and unknown words (מחקה, צוברת, נאמן, מנוטרל מט"ח). I couldn't tell which matter.

stuck.where: Screens 2-4, left column of minus amounts
stuck.why: Red/minus numbers like −447, −3,671 frightened me. I didn't know whose loss that is.
iShares/Vanguard/UCITS. I felt it wasn't for me and stopped.
The cheapest is a firm I don't bank with. Leumi I know but it leaves less.

findings.what: Very busy screens with many coloured tags and numbers. Anxiety-inducing for an older reader
Many minus amounts in the left column look like losses
English fund names and codes with no Hebrew explanation
Jargon in tags (מחקה, צוברת, נאמן, מנוטרל מט"ח) is never explained in plain words
Small, pale notes I couldn't read well (הערה לבדוק, inflation line)
findings.where: Screen 1 result card and settings line

findings.what: Sliders as the main control; the 7% return is filled in as if certain
Opens with 'מדד', which I read as the price index
Unknown companies (ילין לפידות, אינטראקטיב) next to known banks with no word about trust
